scope: Theorem 8.1 (Trace universality) of the manuscript “Functional universality of critical SK autocorrelations” (preprints/Functional-universality-of-critical-SK-autocorrelations-October-5-2026/critical-sk-autocorrelations.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f38734b35e639f88), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 55. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every z > 0, sup 0≤t≤1 EtB[2] n (z) −→ 0. For each finite collection z1, . . . , zm > 0, the vector (Bn(z1), . . . , Bn(zm)) under sign disorder converges in law to the Gaussian limiting vector in (7.1). In particular the coefficient c∗ in that limit is unchanged.
